code: library(attractor) dat <-   seed_sprott_7e(21031) |>   attractor_sprott_7e(1e6, dims = c(400, 400))  dat |>   plot()

code: par(mar = rep(0, 4), mai = rep(0, 4)) dat |>   recolour() |>   plot()

title: Create and Plot Strange Attractors
text: Use recolour() change colours. can use colours defined scales::col_numeric() function. help ?scales::col_numeric(): palette argument can following: character vector RGB named colours. Examples: palette(), c("#000000", "#0000FF", "#FFFFFF"), topo.colors(10) name RColorBrewer palette, e.g. "BuPu" "Greens". function receives single value 0 1 returns colour. Examples: colorRamp(c("#000000", "#FFFFFF"), interpolate="spline"). Use Oranges palette:  change background colour, specify zero_colour:  can also invert palette  Try Spectral palette:  inversion:
code: dat |>   recolour("Oranges") |>   plot() dat |>   recolour("Oranges", zero_colour = "#FFFAF6") |>   plot() dat |>   recolour("Oranges", zero_colour = "grey20", invert = TRUE) |>   plot() dat |>   recolour("Spectral", zero_colour = "#9E0142") |>   plot() dat |>   recolour("Spectral", invert = TRUE, zero_colour = "#5E4FA2") |>   plot()

title: Generate strange attractor. — attractor_generic
text: Numeric vector contains coefficients computing attractor n Number points generate x0 Initial value x y0 Initial value y dims Dimensions resulting matrix, used discretize == TRUE progress Ignored; retained backward compatibility n_discretize Ignored; range set first 1e6 points. Retained backward compatibility. qs Quantile cutoff: single number [0, 0.5). range axis set qs 1 - qs percentiles. parallel_orbit Number independent orbit trajectories run parallel (one per thread default). Use 1 serial orbit. attractor looks either way, counts differ detail, given number trajectories result deterministic. discretize TRUE discretizes matrix dimensions dims, else returns data frame one row every data point

text: Julien C. Sprott, "Strange Attractors: Creating Patterns Chaos", page 418, Equation 7e, http://sprott.physics.wisc.edu/fractals/booktext/sabook.pdf

title: Generate strange attractor using equation 7E of Sprott. — attractor_sprott_7e
code: # Generate the seed vector (14 random values) a <- seed_sprott_7e(fast_forward = 429)  # Generate points, trim at the 0.03 quantile, and discretize to a 600x900 matrix dat <- attractor_sprott_7e(a, n = 1e6, qs = 0.03, dims = c(600, 900))  # Plot using various palettes from `RColorBrewer` plot(recolour(dat, palette = "Oranges"))  plot(recolour(dat, palette = "Greens"))   plot(recolour(dat, palette = "Oranges", zero_colour = "#FFFAF6"))  plot(recolour(dat, palette = "Oranges", zero_colour = "grey20", invert = TRUE))
